To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the level of intangible assets disclosures by Bulgarian enterprises is low; (2) there is a positive relationship between the level of intangibles disclosure and the size of the enterprises; (3) there is a negative relationship between the level intangibles disclosure by enterprises and the sector of their activity; and (4) there is a significant difference between the level of disclosure of intangible data between the two sectors of the Bulgarian furniture industry.
the disclosure of information regarding intangible assets in the financial statements and the notes of furniture enterprises is not at the desired level.
the level of intangible assets disclosures by Bulgarian furniture enterprises is low.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the disclosure practices of the Bulgarian furniture enterprises and their sustainability.
the disclosure of intangibles by Bulgarian furniture enterprises, as a factor for sustainability.
the disclosure of intangibles by Bulgarian furniture enterprises.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the level of disclosure of intangible information is relatively low, which is due to the lack of mandatory reporting and to the lack of voluntary disclosure by the furniture enterprises.
the Bulgarian furniture enterprises disclose the information regarding the intangible assets in a more or less sufficient manner.
Bulgarian furniture enterprises have not disclosed their intangible assets data in a satisfactory way, as well as that they do not have the required level of transparency.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the disclosure of intangibles by Bulgarian furniture enterprises is not satisfactory, but the level of disclosure has been improved in recent years.
the disclosure of the intangible assets by furniture enterprises has increased over time.
the disclosure of intangibles in the financial statements is an indicator of the sustainability of the enterprise and, therefore, the industry.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the disclosure level of intangible assets is not related to the size and age of the enterprise, but it is influenced by the sector of activity and the level of education of the management.
the disclosure of intangibles assets data is influenced by the enterprise’s size and the type of ownership.

Bulgarian enterprises disclose information regarding intangible assets, but the level of this information disclosure varies from enterprise to enterprise, depending on the factors of size, age, ownership and the presence of a board of directors.
